title: Knowing But Not Doing: Convergent Morality and Divergent Action in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ-40) and a custom scenario-based benchmark (VALACT-15K) based on Schwartz's theory of basic human values to compare models' declared values against their enacted decisions in real-world dilemmas.

Evaluating and comparing the value profiles of U.S.-developed and Chinese-developed LLMs to identify homogenized, culture-insensitive normative assumptions and a lack of cross-cultural behavioral diversity.
